neighbours.label: (guess) pieces of names from myth, fantasy and games: Faf|n|ir, Sph|ing|idae, Mega Man
fire: The hero Sigurd slew the dragon Fafnir in the saga.
Hawk moths belong to the family Sphingidae in most books.
Mega Man jumps over the spikes in the next stage.
Fafnir guarded the gold under the heath.
Many Sphingidae fly at dusk near gardens.
A new Mega Man game comes out this spring.
The poem tells how Fafnir became a serpent.
Larvae of Sphingidae are called hornworms.
quiet: The hero Sigurd slew the dragon Grendel in the saga.
Hawk moths belong to a large family in most books.
The hero jumps over the spikes in the next stage.
Dwarves guarded the gold under the heath.
Many moths fly at dusk near gardens.
A new Sonic game comes out this spring.
The poem tells how Odin became a serpent.
Larvae of butterflies are called caterpillars.

notes: Card: mixed pieces, no dominant token. Probes: 'n' in Fafnir 0.98, 'ing' in Sphingidae 0.71, ' Man' 0.44; Supergirl 0.06, coconuts 0.07. One near miss has a saga name and one a game name, on purpose.
